//==
// # Extents and sizes
//
// Non-negative extents rather than positions: the width/height/depth of a
// region. They are deliberately distinct from the vector types, so a size can
// never be mistaken for a displacement, and from the bounding regions above,
// which pair a size with a placement.

// A continuous 2D extent: width and height.
type Size2D
    implements IValue
{
    Width: Number;
    Height: Number;
}
